title: Media / assets index (app/assets.json)
description: Index of every non-markdown upload in the knowledge base — the source of truth the media/assets page (/assets/) renders. Generated by scripts/gen-assets.py; the #6 coverage gate asserts every non-md file appears here exactly once.

path.description: Repo-relative (or absolute/served) path to the asset.

kind.description: Classified kind — drives which viewer opens the asset.

ext.description: Lowercased file extension without the dot (e.g. mp4, pdf).

type.description: Alias surface for ext kept for filter ergonomics.

size.description: Size in bytes (0 when unknown, e.g. session media referenced by URL).

session.description: Owning session id when the asset is session media (sessions.json).

date.description: ISO date — file mtime or the session date.
